s-1.ptxt: Clean Windshield Glass

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper or equivalent, scrape off any adhesive and double-sided tape remaining on the windshield glass. (When reusing windshield glass)

atten3.ptxt: If the painted surface is scratched, perform rust-proofing.

s2.ptxt: Clean the outer circumference of the windshield glass with white gasoline.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to clean new windshield glass as well.

s-1.ptxt: Install Windshield Glass Stopper NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using the specified primer, apply it to the installation area of windshield glass stopper No.2 on the windshield glass.
Install a new windshield glass stopper No.2 to the windshield glass at the position shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Install windshield glass stopper No.2 after the primer has dried (approximately 3 minutes).
Do not install windshield glass stopper No.2 in the wrong direction.
Only the 2 piece type of windshield glass stopper is supplied as a service part, so use the 2 piece type even for vehicles that had the 1 piece type installed.

s-1.ptxt: Install Windshield Glass Stopper NO.1

s2.ptxt: Install a new windshield glass stopper No.1.

atten3.ptxt: Only the 2 piece type of windshield glass stopper is supplied as a service part, so use the 2 piece type even for vehicles that had the 1 piece type installed.

s-1.ptxt: Install Window Glass Adhesive Dam NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using the specified primer, apply it to the windshield glass adhesive dam installation area on the windshield glass.
Install a new windshield glass adhesive dam to the windshield glass at the position shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Install the windshield glass adhesive dam after the primer has dried (approximately 3 minutes).

s-1.ptxt: Install Windshield Outside Moulding

s2.ptxt: Using the specified primer, apply it to the windshield outside moulding installation area on the windshield glass.
Install the windshield outside moulding to the windshield glass at the position shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Install the windshield outside moulding after the primer has dried (approximately 3 minutes).

s-1.ptxt: Install Windshield Glass Assembly

s2.ptxt: Clean Body Installation Surface

s3.ptxt: If the adhesive remaining on the vehicle has significant unevenness, smooth it using a utility knife.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to leave a small amount of adhesive.

s3.ptxt: Clean the body installation surface with white gasoline.

s2.ptxt: Work before Installing Windshield Glass Assembly

s3.ptxt: Attach suction cups to the windshield glass assembly.

Temporarily place the windshield glass assembly on the body and set it in a position where the widths at the top and sides of the windshield glass assembly are uniform (the clearance between the body and the edge of the windshield glass assembly is uniform).
Apply packing tape or equivalent to the windshield glass assembly and body panel, and make matchmarks with a pen for installation. (When using new windshield glass)

atten3.ptxt: Check from inside the vehicle that windshield glass stopper No.1 and windshield glass stopper No.2 are engaged.

atten4.ptxt: When reusing the windshield glass, check and correct the matchmark positions.

s3.ptxt: Using the specified primer, apply it to the areas where the body surface of the vehicle is exposed (where no adhesive remains).

item.ptxt: Do not apply it to the adhesive.
Take particular care when applying it to panel seams and spot weld positions.

s3.ptxt: Using the specified primer, apply it to the bonding area of the windshield glass assembly at the positions shown in the illustration.

s2.ptxt: Cut off the tip of the adhesive nozzle as shown in the illustration below.
Load the adhesive into a sealant gun.
Apply the adhesive in a bead as shown in the illustration below.

atten3.ptxt: Apply the adhesive after the primer has dried (approximately 3 minutes).

s2.ptxt: Holding the suction cups, align the matchmarks and install the windshield glass assembly.

item.ptxt: Install the windshield glass assembly after the primer on the body side has dried (approximately 3 minutes).
Check from inside the vehicle that windshield glass stopper No.1 and windshield glass No.2 are engaged.

s2.ptxt: Lightly press the front surface of the windshield glass assembly to ensure that it is fully sealed.
Using a spatula, correct any excess or insufficient adhesive.

atten3.ptxt: Apply adhesive up to the edge of the windshield glass.

s2.ptxt: Remove any excess adhesive before it hardens.
Using protective tape or equivalent, hold the windshield glass in place until the adhesive hardens.

atten4.ptxt: For the minimum drying time after bonding and the time until the vehicle can be driven, follow the instructions or instruction manual of each adhesive manufacturer.

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector and engage the 2 clamps. (w/ Cold Area Specification)

s-1.ptxt: Inspect for Water Leaks and Repair

s2.ptxt: After the adhesive has hardened, pour water over the vehicle from the outside and check that there is no water leaking into the cabin.
If there is a water leak, allow it to dry and then fill with Three Cement Black.
Remove the protective tape and packing tape that were applied.

s-1.ptxt: Install Roof Headlining Assembly

atten4.ptxt: Install the front part of the roof headlining assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Visor Holder

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws.
Push in the tip of the visor holder to install the visor holder.

atten4.ptxt: Install the LH side using the same procedure.

s-1.ptxt: Install Room Light Assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Insert the guide.
Engage the claws and install the room light cover.

atten4.ptxt: Install the RH side using the same procedure.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws and install the room light lens.
Engage the 4 claws and install room light assembly No.1 to the room light switch base.
Engage the 4 claws and install room light assembly No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Install Assist Grip

s2.ptxt: Install the 2 springs and 2 assist grip covers to the assist grip.
Install the assist grip.

atten4.ptxt: Install the other 3 in the same way.

s-1.ptxt: Install Visor Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Install the 2 springs to the visor assembly RH.
Engage the 2 springs.
Temporarily attach the visor bracket cover to the visor assembly RH.
Engage the 4 claws and install the visor assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Visor Assembly LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Map Light Assembly (w/o Interior Illumination Light)

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector.
Engage the 4 claws and 4 clips, and install the map light assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Interior Illumination Light Assembly NO.1 (w/ Interior Illumination Light)

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector.
Fix the harness to the clamp at the position shown in the illustration.
Engage the 8 clips and install interior illumination light assembly No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Align the paint mark (blue) of the weatherstrip with the arrow part on the body side shown in the illustration, and install the front door opening trim weatherstrip RH.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the corners are not lifted.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip LH

s2.ptxt: Align the paint mark (pink) of the weatherstrip with the arrow part on the body side shown in the illustration, and install the front door opening trim weatherstrip LH.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the corners are not lifted.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the protective cover.
Install a new front pillar garnish clip to the garnish.
Insert the guide at the front end.
Engage the front pillar garnish clip and clip, and install the front pillar garnish RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece RH

s2.ptxt: Insert the 2 guides B.
Engage the 5 claws and 2 guides A, and install the front pillar garnish corner piece RH.
Remove the protective tape that was applied.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the protective cover.
Install a new front pillar garnish clip to the garnish.
Insert the guide at the front end.
Engage the front pillar garnish clip and clip, and install the front pillar garnish LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror: EC Mirror)

s2.ptxt: Slide the inner rear view mirror assembly in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration.
Using a torx socket wrench (T20), install the inner rear view mirror assembly with the screw.
Connect the connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Inner Rear View Mirror Stay Holder Cover (Inner Mirror: EC Mirror)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 6 claws of the inner rear view mirror cover.
Slide it in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration, engage the 2 claws and install the inner rear view mirror cover.

s-1.ptxt: Install Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror: Normal)

s2.ptxt: Slide the inner rear view mirror assembly in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to install it.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the lock lever is securely locked.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws and install the inner rear view mirror cover.

s-1.ptxt: Install Cowl Top Ventilator Louver RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 5 claws and install the cowl top ventilator louver RH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the pin and install the front side panel protector NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Cowl Top Ventilator Louver LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 11 claws and install the cowl top ventilator louver LH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the pin and install the front side panel protector NO.1 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Hood to Cowl Top Seal

s2.ptxt: Engage the 7 clips and install the hood to cowl top seal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Stop the windshield wiper motor assembly at the automatic stop position.
Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the front wiper arm & blade assembly LH with the front wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the front wiper arm nut.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the front wiper arm & blade assembly RH with the front wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the front wiper arm nut.

s2.ptxt: Operate the front wipers while spraying water or washer fluid on the glass, and check the wiping condition of the blades and that they do not interfere with the body.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Install the 2 front wiper arm head caps.
